top_choice_rationale: The optical lattice clock (Katori's magic-wavelength concept and first realisation, Ye's record accuracy and many-body clock physics) is a mature, independently reproduced instrument at the 10^-18 level, distinct from the 2005 frequency-comb and 2012 single-ion prizes, with fundamental-physics reach (redshift over millimetres, drifting constants, ultralight dark matter). The Katori and Ye allocation and the citation scope are well bounded, so awarding it is clearly better than no award.
